qa_flags.question: Umer Raffat (Evercore) asked about incremental Terns/TERN-701 patient data showing an MMR achievement rate as low as ~2 of 10, and whether that changes the drug's profile.
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dean Li did not address the specific low-rate subset directly; he reframed to a broader ITT estimate ('north of 50%') versus the 75% publicly stated by Terns, without reconciling the analyst's cited drop.

qa_flags.question: Louise Chen (Scotiabank) asked what the Street may be missing about the competitiveness of WINREVAIR given debate over the CADENCE data.
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dean Li said he was unsure what was being referenced and declined to engage with the competitive framing, redirecting to the unmet-need narrative instead of addressing the specific debate raised.

qa_flags.question: Leerink分析師Daina Graybosch追問：試驗中約3%患者服藥不順從，是否足以看出這對療效有負面影響？若現實世界的順從率不如試驗中高，是否構成風險？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層（Joerg Koglin）僅反覆強調臨床試驗內的順從率高達97%且效果持久，未正面回應「若現實世界順從率下降，是否構成療效風險」這個假設情境問題

qa_flags.question: Daina Graybosch再次追問：CORALreef Lipids研究因5名患者基線值生物學上不可能而需要用兩種數字（55.8%與59.7%）表述效果，除了敘述上尷尬，這是否構成監管挑戰，或意味著這5名患者以外還有其他問題？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層（Joerg Koglin）以「這是很透明的決定」「科學界並未因此提出質疑」等安撫性語句回應，未具體正面回答是否構成監管挑戰

qa_flags.question: Is that a this-year event or a next-year event? (指700億美元管線數字何時上調)
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給明確時間點，只說「it's coming」與「to be determined in the near term」，語氣保留不承諾時程

qa_flags.question: Maybe just again, any update on when we might see that first set of full Phase III data? Is this something that we could see at the UEGW conference?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 先以「If I could reframe the question a little bit」把焦點從IBD/會議時程轉向更廣的細胞激素節點策略，稍後才簡短回答資料時程

qa_flags.question: what does that mean for your sac-TMT program in the event that, let's say, the biomarker population only is positive?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未正面給判斷，只說會「look very deeply」並強調要看後續資料，屬條件式保留回答
